title: phasecurvefit
details: Fit a curve through phase-space points — streams, orbits, trajectories.

highlight.alt: The phasecurvefit logo: noisy points along a self-crossing looped curve, coloured by their fitted order from red through yellow to blue, with the learned mean path drawn as a black line.
highlight.description: Fits a curve through points in phase space — a stellar stream, an orbit, a trajectory — ordering them along it.
